Synopsis:
A double-hulled ferry carrying 267 passengers capsized off Kyrenia, northern Cyprus, shortly after departing for the Turkish port of Tasucu. At least 8 people died and ~20 remain missing, including two children from the same family. Rough seas following severe storms are implicated. Nine crew/operators were detained. Turkish rescue assets are being deployed to assist with deep-water search operations.
